dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software); uses GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL conventions with COPY includes (.INC files), LINKAGE SECTION parameters, MCP database access pattern typical of ORCA

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance billing (receipt) system - ORCA; subprogram to retrieve special late-night hospitalization basic fee codes (夜勤時間特別入院基本料コード取得)
purpose.summary: This subprogram is part of the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It retrieves and maps special late-night hospitalization basic fee codes based on the calculation year-month and hospital settings. It performs database lookups against the system management table (tbl_syskanri) and then applies code substitution rules for various disease categories (general, tuberculosis, psychiatric) across different revision periods (Heisei 28/30 revisions).

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with COPY-based parameter passing
MCP database access pattern (DBSELECT/DBFETCH/DBCLOSE) typical of ORCA
Large EVALUATE statement for medical fee code mapping
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (decoded as latin-1 garbled)
Date-based branching on Japanese fiscal year revisions (201604, 201804)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary MCP middleware
5 COPY includes for shared data structures
verdict.notes: Comments are in Japanese EUC-JP encoding but the file was decoded as latin-1, resulting in garbled multi-byte characters. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. Source is truncated at 16000 chars but enough structure is visible to classify confidently.
